setup: The power rule: \(\frac{d}{dx} x^{n} = n x^{n-1}\), and a constant factor stays in front.

steps.say: Bring the power down and lower it by one: \(\frac{d}{dx} x^{[[n]]} = [[n]] x^{[[exp]]}\).
Multiply by the constant \([[a]]\): \([[a]] \cdot [[n]] = [[coef]]\), so \(f'(x) = [[coef]] x^{[[exp]]}\).
